scope: Complete native alphabet/default parser scientific operation mapping, including replaceable f64-map parser trait, owned elements, load and verbose stream output; C++ ABI/arbitrary template instantiations and another decomposer engine are not claimed.
fixture_policy: Source literals are embedded directly in tests/ims_alphabet.rs; no copied data fixture files. Isotope/element files are frozen stage dependencies and excluded from extraction.
native_policies: Stable ties replace unspecified source std::sort order.
Parser numbers use portable decimal/scientific prefix grammar, explicit hex rejection and ignored trailing text; no cross-library/locale num_get byte-equivalence claim.
Malformed/nonfinite/overflow/UTF8 and index errors are checked and atomic for native state.
Default parser comment precheck recognizes only SPACE/TAB; token extraction recognizes classic SPACE/TAB/LF/CR/VT/FF.
First parser-map duplicate and first alphabet duplicate lookup/replacement/erase are retained.
Custom parser side effects and computational policy belong to its implementation; returned map is revalidated before alphabet commit.
Verbose stream output is not a flat loadable codec; source has no flat store method.
